title: Text: DET David Chadd ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Thank you for getting back to me yesterday when I had news I could have broken, 90 min before you guys announced it
I’m not trying to cover the Tigers my whole life, Im working hard to get this kind of info and I’m not going to be wrong about it, that’s why I check in
Yeah Al’s been screwing me too
And I’ve told you countless times I’m never going to jeopardize my job for not being loyal and leaking info that I’ve been told not to leak! Sorry but that’s the way it is!
Whatever, just sharing my thoughts. I respect that. You all act like these are the nuclear codes
Yeah, it’s whatever. I respect your stance but you know how these things go. Have a good thanksgiving
